author: Pecos Hank
description:
What’s the best vehicle for storm chasing? After more than 30 years of chasing storms, 750,000 miles on my previous chase vehicles, and experience in rentals with everything from economy cars to full-size SUVs and trucks, I'm breaking down what actually makes the best storm-chasing vehicle.

From Toyota 4Runners and RAV4s to pickup trucks, sedans, crossovers, Subarus, Jeeps, and economy cars, we'll examine the pros, cons, and real-world trade-offs of different storm-chasing vehicles. I'll share what worked, what didn't, and what matters most when you're spending endless miles on the road pursuing tornadoes and severe weather.

We'll look at the practical considerations that often get overlooked: fuel economy, reliability, handling in heavy rain and strong winds, ground clearance, cargo space, tires, hail protection, and the cost of outfitting a dedicated chase vehicle.

title: What’s the BEST Vehicle for Storm Chasing?
